caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with an open rectangular frame, featuring turned spindles on all four sides and prominently rounded posts at each corner. The cradle is colored in various shades of brown, indicating wood, with detailed shading to suggest depth and the cylindrical shape of the spindles and posts. The base of the cradle has two curved rockers, one at each end, which are also brown with some darker shading underneath suggesting a shadow on the light cream or off-white background. The overall composition centers the cradle, filling most of the image space, and the drawing is signed in small red letters near the bottom right corner with the name "Joe Brennan Jr."
title: Doll's Cradle
